architecture.summary: Add optional manual L4 detail to the existing L3 architecture comparison guide only when a callable contract is added, removed, or materially changed and the L3 drawing with behavior notes is insufficient. Scope the detail to one named component and container, use only relevant code elements and relationships with the same change colors and text labels, and exclude internal refactors that preserve caller-visible behavior. L3 remains the main comparison. This changes manual review guidance only and adds no automated gate. Human approval, test, metrics, review-tier, and merge rules remain unchanged. The context, container, component, runtime, and deployment views remain accurate because no application source, contracts, runtime configuration, responsibilities, collaborations, external systems, resource ownership, or deployment placement changes. Production architecture metrics are not applicable; no registry edit is needed.
